jobs.occupation: Vehicle Testing Engineer Internship, Tesla Engineering Germany (m/w/d) (Sekretär/in)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

The Vehicle Test team is seeking a highly motivated intern to perform tests of vehicle components and parts including seats, closures, interiors, structures, thermal systems. You will focus on hands-on testing and design of test equipment. You will work closely with senior engineers to execute tests, build fixtures, and analyze data in a fast-paced environment. At Tesla, scope and complexity of your assignments are limited by your aptitude, not seniority or title. 

What You’ll Do

- Gain experience in cross-disciplinary teams by applying first-principles thinking to vehicle component testing.
- Support the execution of tests for seats, closures, interiors, structures, thermal systems according to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
- Design and build mechanical and electrical test fixtures for tests inside and outside of environmental chambers.
- Process raw test data to help draw meaningful conclusions and assist in preparing high-quality reports for internal technical teams
- Participate in destructive teardowns for root-cause analysis, meticulously documenting findings and observations.
- Gain exposure to and learn about full battery pack testing methodologies.
- Collaborate with test technicians and engineers.
- Contribute to organizational tasks & responsibilities like creation & maintenance of procedures, SOPs, standards, equipment, inspections, lab commissioning, facilities, maintenance and staff trainings.
- Acquire knowledge about relevant industry standards, testing guidelines, and norms.
- Tasks require work with hazardous materials using mandated PPE and to set up and perform tests in person and in lab environments.
- 25% travel to test locations is expected if required for the project.
- Other tasks as required. 

What You’ll Bring

- Pursuing a degree in a relevant field (Mechanical, Electrical, Automotive, Chemical Engineering, Physics, or similar).
- Experience with electronic controllers, CAN communication is required.
- 3D Design/CAD skills and creation of fundamental wiring and hydraulics diagrams are required.
- Solid grasp on engineering fundamentals, such as thermal dynamics, fluid dynamics, heat transfer, mechanics and electronics.
- A strong hands-on mindset with experience or keen interest in building, assembling, and troubleshooting mechanical or electrical equipment
- Initial experience in MATLAB/Python or other software for data processing is required.
- Fluency in English; German is a plus.
- Analytical and problem-solving oriented mindset.
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills.Additional Preferred Skills
- Initial experience in an OEM or equipment/machine manufacturer is a plus
- Experience with Labview and Data acquisition systems is a plus
- Project management experience or foundations are a plus

jobs.occupation: Lead Mechanical Design Engineer, Power Electronics (m/f/d) (Data Engineer)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

Please not: roles are open at multiple seniority levels for demonstrated excellence.At Tesla Engineering Germany in Freiburg, we're building the future of sustainable energy by developing innovative power electronics for energy storage and vehicle charging systems. You will own the cradle-to-grave mechanical design of tightly integrated, high-volume electromechanical systems, from first concept through prototyping and validation to mass production. You'll work closely with Electrical, Product, Reliability, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain teams. This is an opportunity to own key projects, use modern tools, and work in state-of-the-art facilities on power electronics that ship in Tesla products worldwide. Your work contributes directly to the world's transition to sustainable energy. At the lead level, you will also set technical direction and guide a small team of mechanical engineers.

What You’ll Do

- Own the electromechanical design of injection-molded plastics, sheet metal, high-pressure die castings, heat sinks / cold plates, insulation systems, magnetics, HV/LV interconnects, busbars, and PCBA-adjacent structures
- Solve electronics packaging end-to-end: thermal management, high-voltage insulation (creepage/clearance), IP67+ sealing, EMI, shock/vibration, and long-term environmental reliability
- Lead track: Serve as technical owner of a product line, mentor 3–4+ engineers, lead and approve design reviews, and enforce technical rigor and schedule discipline
- Analyze before you cut metal: thermal / CFD, structural FEA, tolerance stacks, DFM / DFA / DFR, and DFMEA where it matters
- Design custom magnetics and power interfaces (inductors, transformers, chokes, terminals) as first-class mechanical products, not afterthoughts
- Partner with electrical, systems, reliability, manufacturing, supply chain, and compliance teams, and design against UL / IEC / GB standards through to certification
- Drive prototypes into reality: builds, test support, characterization, design verification, and root-cause analysis of failures
- Release for production in CATIA 3DEXPERIENCE: 3D models, 2D drawings with GD&T, PLM / ECOs / BOMs, and supplier collaboration for automated manufacturing at thousands of units per week

What You’ll Bring

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience; Master’s degree preferred for senior/ staff/ lead level
- Strong mechanical fundamentals and a physics-based, first-principles approach to structural and thermal problems
- Proven product design ownership from concept to scaled production (portfolio preferred)
- Lead track: 7+ years of relevant product design experience, including 2+ years of design leadership
- Fluency in CATIA V5 / 3DEXPERIENCE, GD&T, tolerance analysis, and design for high-volume processes (molding, stamping, die casting, fastening, joining, dispensing)
- Ability to run, or critically review, thermal / CFD / structural analysis, plus working knowledge of power electronics components (PCBAs, MOSFETs, inductors, transformers)
- Detail-oriented, with clear written and verbal communication in English and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment Highly valued:
- Direct experience in power electronics packaging: inverters, chargers, DC-DC, magnetics, busbars, or HV semiconductor modules
- Experience designing against certification standards (UL, IEC, GB) and obtaining certificates
- Multiphysics intuition: heat transfer, fluids, mechanics, and materials (magnetics a strong plus)
- MATLAB / Python for data reduction, scripting, or reduced-order thermal models
- PLM / change control / BOM discipline in a fast-moving product environment
- Hands-on lab instinct: you would rather instrument a prototype than argue from a slide
